title: Email Validator
h1: Email Address Validator — Check Emails Free
seoTitle: Email Validator — Free Online Email Checker
description: Validate one or many email addresses against a standard pattern. Instant results, private and free. Runs in your browser.
intro: Paste one email or a list (one per line) and see which ones look valid. Useful for cleaning contact lists.
blurb: Check if email addresses are valid.
howItWorks: Paste one or more email addresses, one per line.
Each address is marked Valid or Invalid, with a summary count.
examples: Clean a list of newsletter subscribers.
Quickly check a single address before sending.

faq.q: Is this a full RFC check?
faq.a: It uses a practical regular expression that catches most invalid addresses. It does not verify that the mailbox actually exists.
No. Validation runs entirely in your browser.

faq.q: Can I paste many at once?
faq.a: Yes. Put one address per line.
